meta.description: Quantifies alternative splicing as PSI from RNA-seq with rMATS-turbo, SUPPA2, MAJIQ V3, leafcutter, VAST-TOOLS, Shiba and IRFinder, with event taxonomy, tool selection, quality thresholds and reconciliation rules.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; planted PSI, formula, SUPPA2 and rMATS values reproduce; unexecuted tools and literature figures are labelled

practice_boundaries.detail: Research-method Skill with no clinical conclusions; disease signatures are cited literature

methodological_ground.detail: Effective-length PSI, both-group replicate reliability, tool-family reconciliation and sign conventions held

code_usability.detail: Inline snippet and parse_rmats_output run on real rMATS output for all five event types, JC and JCEC, and match an independent oracle; SUPPA2, regtools/leafcutter and IRFinder commands run as written; a zero-event file raises a loud KeyError (SQ-12, P2)

functional_suitability.note: Taxonomy, tool selection, effective-length PSI, SUPPA2, regtools/leafcutter and IRFinder commands all reproduce on real tool output; the shipped parser agrees with an independent oracle for all five event types; JC length statement is exact only for typical events (SQ-13)

reliability.note: XS-tag prerequisite and strand check, SUPPA2 header and pin, and clear unsupported-event errors; a legitimate zero-event rMATS file still raises a raw KeyError (SQ-12) and leafcutter exits 0 with zero clusters on untagged BAMs (documented)

performance_context.note: SKILL.md 294 lines with failure modes and IR/microexon detail routed to references; tool matrix and decision tree still overlap

agent_usability.note: Decision tables, thresholds and reconciliation rules are clear; BAM-list format, TPM header contract, XS prerequisite and JC/JCEC lengths are now stated

human_usability.note: Good pitfalls and prompts; literature figures are labelled; one unhelpful raw error on empty rMATS files

security.note: No credentials; subprocess calls use argument lists; no shell interpolation

maintainability.note: Small modular script with per-type column map and parameterised thresholds and docstrings; no tests and a single dependency pin

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger description; progressive disclosure works; Related Skills resolve; restricted and heavy surfaces are labelled not executed

recommendations.title: parse_rmats_output raises a raw KeyError on an rMATS file with zero events
recommendations.problem: A header-only MATS file (an event type with no events, as in the planted rMATS run for A5SS, A3SS, MXE and RI) makes DataFrame.apply return an empty frame, then df['min_reads_per_replicate'] raises KeyError.
recommendations.root_cause: The per-row statistics are added with concat on an apply result that is empty for an empty table.
recommendations.fix: Return an empty frame with the expected columns (or raise a ValueError naming the empty file) when the table has no rows; add a header-only test. (SQ-12)

recommendations.title: JC IncFormLen/SkipFormLen stated as constants
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md says JC lengths are 2*(readLength-1) and readLength-1; on real chrX data only 719 of 958 SE rows have 148/74 (58 distinct pairs), the rest are smaller where short exons or introns limit read positions.
recommendations.root_cause: Planted single-exon data (98/49) was generalised to all events.
recommendations.fix: Say the values are the maximum for exons and introns longer than a read, and that rMATS prints the per-event lengths in the file. (SQ-13)
